summary: Complete DNS authentication setup guide for tdgamestudio.com to maximize cold email deliverability. Covers 5 layers: SPF (missing - critical), DMARC upgrade from p=none to p=quarantine, TLS-RPT for monitoring, MTA-STS for TLS enforcement, and BIMI for logo display in inbox. Includes exact copy-paste values for VietNIX DNS panel and verification steps.
